questions.answer: In the Bible, in Church, and through others
choices: In the Bible, in Church, and through others
questions.explanation: God speaks to us in many ways, including through the Bible, during Church services, and through the people in our lives.
questions.hint: Think about where we pray and what we read.
questions.prompt: Where does God speak to us?
questions.subject: Religion

questions.explanation: The Bible teaches that Jesus is the best way God communicates His message to us.
questions.hint: He is God's greatest gift.
questions.prompt: Who is the best way God speaks to us?
questions.subject: Religion

questions.explanation: The Bible consists of two major sections: the Old Testament and the New Testament.
questions.hint: There are two main parts.
questions.prompt: The Bible is broken into the Old and New Testament.
questions.subject: Religion

questions.explanation: At Baptism, original sin is washed away and we receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.
questions.hint: It is the tendency to sin we are born with.
questions.prompt: What is washed away at Baptism?
questions.subject: Religion

questions.explanation: Mary is recognized as the Mother of the Church.
questions.hint: She is also Jesus' mother.
questions.prompt: Who is the Mother of the Church?
questions.subject: Religion

questions.explanation: Jesus is the head of the Church, while we are the body.
questions.hint: He is God's son.
questions.prompt: Who is the head of the Church?
questions.subject: Religion

questions.explanation: Faith is a gift from God that helps us believe in Him.
questions.hint: It is a gift received at Baptism.
questions.prompt: What gift from God helps us believe?
questions.subject: Religion

questions.explanation: The Trinity is three persons in one God: Father, Son, and Holy Spirit.
questions.hint: Think of the Father, Son, and Holy Spirit.
questions.prompt: The Trinity is four persons in one God.
questions.subject: Religion

questions.explanation: Chop is a word using the consonant digraph 'ch'.
questions.hint: Starts with the 'ch' digraph.
questions.prompt: Build the word that means to cut something with a quick blow.
questions.subject: Spelling

questions.explanation: Phone uses the 'ph' digraph.
questions.hint: Uses the 'ph' digraph for the /f/ sound.
questions.prompt: Build the word for a device used to make calls.
questions.subject: Spelling

questions.explanation: Thin uses the 'th' digraph.
questions.hint: Starts with the 'th' digraph.
questions.prompt: Build the word that means the opposite of thick.
questions.subject: Spelling

questions.explanation: Words like 'mule' follow the u_e pattern for a long u sound.
questions.hint: Look for the silent e at the end.
questions.prompt: Which word has a long 'u' sound (u_e)?
questions.subject: Reading

questions.explanation: Hope uses the o_e pattern for the long o sound.
questions.hint: The silent e makes the vowel say its name.
questions.prompt: Which word has a long 'o' sound (o_e)?
questions.subject: Reading

questions.explanation: Diagrams and labels are text features that help explain information in a story.
questions.hint: Think about how books show information.
questions.prompt: A diagram with labels is a type of text feature.
questions.subject: Reading

questions.explanation: A sacrament is a sacred sign given to the Church by Jesus.
questions.hint: Baptism is one of these.
questions.prompt: What is the sacred sign given to the Church by Jesus?
questions.subject: Religion

questions.explanation: Church leaders act in Jesus' name and guide the Church.
questions.hint: They guide the members.
questions.prompt: Who are the people that guide the Church and act in Jesus' name?
questions.subject: Religion

questions.explanation: Alive means something is living.
questions.hint: It is the opposite of dead.
questions.prompt: What does the word 'alive' mean?
questions.subject: Reading

questions.explanation: Giant means something is very large.
questions.hint: Think of something huge.
questions.prompt: What does 'giant' mean?
questions.subject: Reading

questions.explanation: Offspring refers to the young of a person, animal, or plant.
questions.hint: Baby bears are the offspring of a mother bear.
questions.prompt: Which word means the young of an animal?
questions.subject: Reading

questions.explanation: Catch is one of the review words on the spelling list.
questions.hint: Ends with the 'tch' sound.
questions.prompt: Build the word that means to take hold of something that is moving.
questions.subject: Spelling

studyNotes: God speaks to us in the Bible, in Church, and through others.
Jesus is the best way God speaks to us.
At Baptism, original sin is washed away and we receive the Holy Spirit, faith, and grace.
Jesus is the head of the Church, Mary is the Mother of the Church, and we are the body.
The Trinity consists of three persons in one God: Father, Son, and Holy Spirit.

topics: The Bible: Old and New Testament

studyNotes: Focus on CVCe words and silent e rules.
Identify text features in informational stories.
Practice consonant digraphs: ch, sh, th, wh, ph.

topics: Stories: Eagles and Eaglets, Baby Bears, From Caterpillar to Butterfly
Phonics: Long o (o_e), short o, long u (u_e), short u
Reading Comprehension: Main idea, details, diagrams, and labels

pack.summary: This week, students are exploring God's message in Religion, focusing on Baptism and the Bible. In Reading and Phonics, the class is studying life cycles through stories like 'Eagles and Eaglets' while practicing consonant digraphs and long/short vowel sounds. Preparation for upcoming tests on singular and plural nouns and three-letter blends is also underway.
